summary: Searches a linked list of loaded surfaces (head at this[67], this+0x10C) for a node matching key a2. Traverses using the next pointer at node offset 0x54 (v2+84), comparing each node via sub_588410 (0 result = match). Returns the surface handle at node offset 0x50 (v2+80) when found, or 0 when a2 is null, the list is empty, or the list is exhausted. Invoked by TimedAnimationTrigger (00486730), UILargeRender (00496930) and TextureSurfaceLoader (00497d20) to resolve a surface by name.

local_names.a2: search key (surface name) compared against each node
local_names.v2: current node being examined during the list walk

operations.description: Null-guard on the search key a2: if (!a2) return 0 immediately
v2 = this[67] reads the head of the loaded-surface list at this+0x10C
Empty-list guard: if the head v2 is null, return 0 (no nodes to search)
Call sub_588410(v2, a2) as a string/id comparison against the current node; a truthy result means 'not a match' and the walk continues
Walk: while sub_588410(v2, a2) is truthy (mismatch), advance v2 = *(_DWORD*)(v2+84), the next pointer at node offset 0x54; if the next pointer is null, return 0 (key not found)
Return *(_DWORD*)(v2+80), the surface handle at node offset 0x50, once a matching node is found
